title: 工程英语
text: The tolerance is plus 0.02 mm. Injection molding is precise.

title: 第15段旁白
text: "This is my bridge. From a silent gear in the workshop to a confident voice in the global market. What about your bridge? Let’s bridge our ordinary work to global voices, and meet a better version of ourselves.

title: 第14段旁白
text: Looking back, English did not just bring our factory more orders; it built a bridge to a stronger, more confident version of myself. I learned that technology has no borders, and lifelong learning has no age limit. I am a mold technician, but I am also an open education student.

title: 第13段旁白
text: Because of this seamless communication, our customer satisfaction skyrocketed, and our overseas orders increased by 35% this year! We didn't just save a deal; we opened a gate to the global market.

title: 第12段旁白
text: The bridge was built, and the impact was immediate. When clients came to our workshop for final acceptance, I guided them myself. I walked them through our CNC and EDM areas, explaining our quality control in fluent, technical English. The skeptical looks of foreign buyers turned into deep, unshakeable trust.

title: 第11段旁白
text: There was a moment of silence. Then, Peter smiled, gave me a thumbs-up, and said: 'Perfect! You are the first technical manager who truly understands our language. We can signe the contract right now.

title: 第10段旁白
text: Then came the trial by fire. It was another a video conference with an European automotive supplier. They were worried about weld lines on the cosmetic parts. This time, I didn't hide in the back. I stepped in front of the camera. I took the microphone and said: 'Dear Peter, don't worry. We can work out the solution to the problem. To eliminate the weld line, we will modify the cold slug well and raise the mold temperature around the gate by 15.degrees . Raising temperature this way improves flow and gets rid of weld‑lines.

title: 第9段旁白
text: Another big hurdle in my English learning was pronunciation and intonation. After years of silence, every word felt stiff and awkward, and I could never tell if I was saying it right. Fortunately, the AI pronunciation tool in the "iGuoKai" App cleared that hurdle for me. It integrates teaching, practice, and testing, with unlimited attempts for learning, reading along, and self-checking. With persistent practice, my pronunciation improved. Those dull technical terms suddenly came to life. Words like "cavity," "venting," and "tolerance"—I mastered them one by one. This smart learning platform, with its AI pronunciation tool, became my most vivid mobile classroom.

title: 第8段旁白
text: "Balancing demanding factory shifts with late-night study was the hardest trial I’ve ever faced. But the digital platform of OUC became my 24-hour smart classroom.

title: 第7段旁白
text: I attended the 2025 freshman orientation conference of Xiamen Open University with steadfast confidence. The university leaders encouraged us with the real-life stories of outstanding former students, and especially commended the resilient spirit of us working students in balancing work and study. Their words were resolute and struck a chord deep within us; at that moment, my determination to pursue my studies grew even stronger.

title: 第6段旁白
text: The answer was a clear 'No.' I refused to remain silent. I chose to change, and I found my lifeline at the National Open University. I enrolled in Science and Technology English 3 and 4. Through the two coursedI can not noly  learn conversational English, but also master the professional vocabulary of my own craft."

title: 第5段旁白
text: "That night, looking at the unsigned contract on my desk, a strong voice inside me woke up. 'Is this it? Am I going to let a language barrier limit my technical potential and my company's future?'

title: 第4段旁白
text: In the injection mold workshop, I know every slider, cavity, and cooling channel like the back of my hand. Our precision is measured down to 0.01mm. But in the global market, we faced a giant language barrier. I felt like a silent gear—essential to the machine, but forever trapped in my own workshop."

title: 第3段旁白
text: Standing behind the sales rep, I knew exactly where the problem was—it was a matter of holding pressure and gate balance. I tried to explain to the client. But I opened my mouth, and all that came out was: "This... this, pressure... no, no." The client just stared back at me with a blank look.

title: 第2段旁白
text: I remember a critical T1 mold trial. In  the video conference, the overseas client noticed a shrinkage defect on the product. Our sales rep struggled to explain the technical details， but they just couldn't get the message across to the client's satisfaction.

title: 第一段开场白
text: I'm Lai Shengfei, a mold-making tech supervisor working on the shop floor.  I used to work quietly in my technical comfort zone. The turning point came at Xiamen Open University. This learning journey sharpened my manufacturing skills and, at the same time, turned off the "mute mode" in English communication.When fluent English came out of this mold maker's mouth,  I knew I was no longer just a behind-the-scenes worker, but a technical speaker confident in international conversations.
